method.notes: Potato-to-egg ratio follows the reference range. Wheat flour is measured as binder and coating, and six thin patties are cooked with weighed oil and a 71 °C endpoint. Full oil retention is modelled as an upper estimate, with 75% and 50% giving 2.25 g and 4.5 g less fat per serving.

food_safety.notes: Potatoes are fully boiled and the egg-bound patties reach 71 °C in the centre.

servings_and_time.notes: 2 portions with 60 minutes including the specified cooking and resting or cooling periods.
